name: omnishield/disposable
description: Omnishield Disposable: is this e-mail's domain a disposable one - the free disposable-email-domains list (CC0) shipped in the package, an allow list and a deny list of the site's, subdomains included; no call while a request runs, a command to refresh the list.

suggest.symfony/http-client: Refreshing the list through the application's HTTP client (bin/omnishield-disposable works without it)
